topic: How to help your teen land their first dog walking client this week
caption:
Your teen could earn their first $15 this week with a handwritten note and a 20-minute walk around the block.

Have them list 3 neighbors with dogs, write a simple intro offering $15 per walk, and drop it off today.

First clients almost always come from people who already know and trust your family.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
